title: Styles next to each view
summary: A `tac.css` file next to a component view is the stylesheet of that component. A component folder holds only its view and its stylesheet. A page holds no CSS file in any folder (`TY1309`). The compiler wraps the stylesheet in CSS `@scope`, which limits styles to one part of the page. The scope starts at the component and stops at every nested component, also one without a stylesheet and one placed in a slot. So the rules of a parent never style a child component. Tachyon does not rewrite selectors. Component HTML cannot hold a `<style>` element or a stylesheet link (`TY1403`). Global colors, fonts, custom properties and resets go in the stylesheets that `tac.styles` lists in `client/manifest.json`; layout and animation stay in the component's `tac.css`. A third-party stylesheet is declared in `tac.styleSources` with its package, exact version, license and SHA-256. Other global CSS stops the build with `TY1403`. A Python service also needs the `tac.python` runtime setting in `client/manifest.json`.
